mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocktake_order (order_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO stocktake_order_item (order_id, sku_id, snapshot_physical, snapshot_available, snapshot_locked, counted_physical) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{snapshotPhysical}, #{snapshotAvailable}, #{snapshotLocked}, #{countedPhysical})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stocktake_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM stocktake_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE stocktake_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE stocktake_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
